name: Thoai Ngoc Hau Tomb
kicker: Tomb at the foot of Núi Sam
summary: Tomb at the foot of Núi Sam: see Thoại Ngọc Hầu's ground on the same morning as the shrine. The 2026 festival carries his spirit tablet from here to Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ and back. He and his wife Châu Thị Tế are remembered for opening land and digging the Vĩnh Tế canal. Look for the old gate.
getThere: Same cluster as Ba Chua Xu Temple, at the mountain.
heroCaption: The gate of Lăng Thoại Ngọc Hầu, with the mountain slope behind it

notice.title: The tablet leaves during the festival
notice.body: The tomb is at the foot of Núi Sam, with the shrine. In the 2026 festival the spirit tablet goes from this ground to Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ and comes back. On those days the tablet is in the procession.

body: See the tomb of the mandarin tied to the shrine. The 2026 opening staged Thoại Ngọc Hầu and Châu Thị Tế as the people who opened land and dug the Vĩnh Tế canal. During the festival the tablet procession uses this ground. On another morning it is a stop on the walk with the temple.
The old gate has the slope of Núi Sam behind it. Inside, the tomb houses fill the courtyard. The visit is the gate and the ground.
The tomb is at the mountain, with the temple, in phường Vĩnh Tế.

figures.caption: Tomb houses inside Lăng Thoại Ngọc Hầu
figures.alt: Stone tomb houses in the courtyard of Thoai Ngoc Hau Tomb at Sam Mountain

gettingThere: The tomb is at the foot of Núi Sam, in the same cluster as Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ in phường Vĩnh Tế. No separate distance was printed.

legs.heading: From Ba Chua Xu Temple
legs.body: On foot, in the same cluster. A published walking minute was not found. Minutes are check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day was published. During the festival the tablet procession uses this ground.
